what: Pressing creates a dotted selection border, and dragging makes the element follow the hand 0.4s late, overshoot slightly, then settle — the heavy drag of a hand-drawn map selection tool

options.bounds: if true, it can’t leave its parent

from.where: index.html map board picker (press a symbol and drag)

note: The four corner handles of the selection box are drawn with CSS backgrounds, and unlike the original, the item is not re-inserted to sit in front of the ones below after dropping — it is raised while selected · on phones (no hover) it is not draggable — so pushing on it still scrolls the page down
